title: Collaborative Workflows static contract schemas
description: Closed record, projection, request and result shapes for Plans/Collaborative_Workflows.md sections 10 to 12, PART-001..020 and the Wand Modules Redesign Addendum (CWR-018..CWR-039). Static schema and fixture consistency only: no writer, storage key, EventRecord, native handler or production wiring is admitted, and every command stays handler_unavailable. Fields that wait on an owner answer recorded as an open ledger question are not admitted.

run_state.description: Closed run states of sections 2.1 and 12.

admission_source.description: Closed run admission_source of CWR-021 and section 12.

participant_outcome.description: Closed terminal slot outcomes of PART-001..006.

attention_reason.description: Closed attention_reason of CWR-029. The limit_reached member waits on an owner decision (ledger question q-007/q-018) and is not admitted here.

participant_activity_state.description: Closed presentation states of the participant activity projection (CWR-030).

brainstorm_phase.description: The seven ordered BrainStorm phases of section 8.5 by canonical name; CWR-027 maps each to its plain display label.

collaboration_error.description: The closed typed error enumeration of section 11.

composer_buffer_error.description: Refusals of ComposerBufferResult: the section 11 errors plus composer_not_empty (CWR-031, DL-125).

coordinator_spec.description: Typed coordinator_spec of CWR-037. parent_assistant is this chat's assistant; participant_slot names one of the run's slots, which then leads and also does a part; dedicated_model adds one lead with its own requested identity. A Chat Room Moderator row writes the same field.

hard_constraint.description: One BrainStorm must-have of CWR-027: {id, text, source}, frozen with the definition at Start.

ParticipantSpec.description: ParticipantSpec of sections 2.2 and 12. Requested fields only: effective values live in the runtime assignment record. A specialist is a spec with additive_role_kind set and its own requested model (CWR-028); Grill Me is a methodology Skill and never a Persona (DL-133), so its spec carries no Persona.

CollaborativeDefinition.description: CollaborativeDefinition of section 12 and CWR-032. A committed sheet is fully described by its revision. Kind fields appear only on their kind. There is no substitution policy field: an unavailable chosen model blocks Start (CWR-034).

permission_ceiling_ref.description: Shown and never configured upward (CWR-032); a reference to the inherited ceiling, not a setting.

stuck_policy.description: What happens when a participant is stuck (CWR-032); default ask_user. Under every value no participant is swapped, skipped or waived without an explicit user action. The value set beyond the default is not closed by the owner.

evidence_citation_rule.description: The evidence each Review finding must cite (CWR-025); default file_and_line. The owner fixes only the default, so the value set stays open.

CollaborativeRun.description: CollaborativeRun of section 12. A run admitted by Crew Auto records the crew_auto_revision that admitted it (CWR-021); a Build With Crew run binds the exact Plan (CWR-023).

CollaborationMessage.description: The single durable transcript record for all four kinds (section 2.3).

QuestionBank.description: One shared question registry per BrainStorm run (section 8.4). The allowance table, counter and charge point are owned by Plans/Assistant_Plan_Runtime.md (QMAX-001..016).

ReviewTargetPack.description: The frozen target pack of section 7.2, called the snapshot on screen (CWR-025, DL-134). Also give them: test results to test_build_evidence_refs, taught rules to user_constraint_refs.

ReviewFinding.description: A normalized Review finding (sections 7.5 and 12). It never aggregates votes drawn from differing target hashes; that cross-vote equality is a runtime invariant this static shape records per vote but cannot compare.

waiver.description: An explicit waiver identifies actor, reason and currentness (PART-001..006).

ParticipantDisposition.description: Each slot reaches exactly one explicit terminal outcome (PART-001..006). explicitly_waived carries its waiver; no other outcome does.

allowed_action.description: One recovery or follow-on action valid for the run now, mapped to exactly one existing command (CWR-029). The Review actions of CWR-026 are fixed to their commands.

CompletionProjection.description: The only input to a card's clean result and its decision row (PART-016..020, CWR-029). clean_completion is true only when the kind's completion predicate, required dispositions, output finalisation and every pending user decision are resolved, so it never coexists with an attention reason.

ParticipantActivity.description: The participant activity projection of CWR-030: derived on read, never persisted, emitted or replayed. It references the EP-128 stream vocabulary and never redefines it. The schema_id names the projection shape only.

quote_source_id.description: A lane quote comes only from the participant's own complete, durable message, referenced here; raw tool output is never quoted (CWR-030).

preset_row.description: A preset row has the shape of a participant spec (CWR-039).

TeamPreset.description: A built-in team preset of CWR-039: {id, label, helper, rows, config_overrides}.

config_overrides.description: Definition fields the sheet exposes; a preset only prefills the draft and never writes a definition, a Settings value or a run (CWR-018, CWR-039).

review_target_choice.description: The Review target the user chose at Start (MODAL-009..010, CWR-025): the current version or the version the sheet opened with, identified by its pre-freeze digest from the target preview query. Start freezes the chosen side.

start_blocker.description: A row whose chosen model, account or Persona is unavailable: Start is blocked until the user replaces it (CWR-034, DL-121).

CollaborationConfigureRequest.description: cmd.collaboration.configure validates and previews configuration only; it creates no run, no card and no Usage (MODAL-003..005).

source_surface.description: A registered source surface of the command's catalog row; the surface census is owned by Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md.

CollaborationConfigureResult.description: Returns the definition revision only; it carries no run identity because configure never starts a run (MODAL-003..005, section 10).

CollaborationStartRequest.description: Requires a committed definition revision; idempotent on idempotency_key. A Review start carries the chosen target side, frozen at Start (MODAL-009..010).

source_surface.description: A registered source surface of the command's catalog row; the surface census is owned by Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md.

admission_source.description: Build With Crew is dispatched by cmd.chat.plan.build_with_crew and never by cmd.collaboration.start (CWR-022).

CollaborationStartResult.description: A committed start returns run identity, state, slot identities and the snapshot ref; a failed start creates no run and no partial participant records (MODAL-003..005).

source_surface.description: A registered source surface of the command's catalog row; the surface census is owned by Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md.

CollaborationPauseResult.description: Typed mutation result (section 11): a failure never advances state, carries its typed error and no work, receipt replay or revision.

source_surface.description: A registered source surface of the command's catalog row; the surface census is owned by Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md.

CollaborationResumeResult.description: Resume continues the same run: no second run identity. A refusal names its reason (section 10).

source_surface.description: A registered source surface of the command's catalog row; the surface census is owned by Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md.

CollaborationCancelResult.description: Cancel retains card, transcript, participants and artifacts with truthful cancelled state and returns a cancellation receipt (section 10).

CollaborationMessageRequest.description: Delivers one user message exactly once; unavailable on a completed, cancelled or failed run with the printed reason (CWR-031).

source_surface.description: A registered source surface of the command's catalog row; the surface census is owned by Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md.

delivery_mode.description: The chat's busy-send rule (DL-108, UCC-168) applied to a Chat Room round in progress (CWR-024, DL-112): queue by default, steer without interrupting. Who receives a steer is still open (ledger q-025).

CollaborationMessageResult.description: One durable message referenced by both the thread and the collaboration transcript (section 2.3).

open_focus.description: Optional focus of cmd.collaboration.open: a tab, a participant_id or a finding_id (CWR-031).

source_surface.description: A registered source surface of the command's catalog row; the surface census is owned by Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md.

CollaborationOpenResult.description: run_view opens one editor-pane document per run with the stable id kind prefix plus collaboration_run_id (CWR-020); opening again focuses it. Route success is not run success.

source_surface.description: A registered source surface of the command's catalog row; the surface census is owned by Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md.

CollaborationParticipantOpenResult.description: Opens the exact participant transcript; an empty participant returns a truthful empty transcript (section 10).

CollaborationExportRequest.description: Exports the referenced transcript or artifact version and hash through the artifact and file owners; never re-renders (section 10, CWR-031).

source_surface.description: A registered source surface of the command's catalog row; the surface census is owned by Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md.

CollaborationExportResult.description: Typed mutation result (section 11): a failure never advances state, carries its typed error and no work, receipt replay or revision.

reconfigure_change.description: One explicit reconfiguration (PART-001..006, CWR-024, CWR-026, CWR-031). Replacement always carries the new requested identity; a waiver carries its reason (actor and currentness ride on the request).

CollaborationReconfigureRequest.description: Bumps the definition revision under the expected-revision check. accept_stale_target true finishes a stale Review on its old pack (finish_stale) and is accepted only while the run reports target_pack_stale (CWR-031).

source_surface.description: A registered source surface of the command's catalog row; the surface census is owned by Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md.

CollaborationReconfigureResult.description: Records a system transcript entry and never rewrites attribution. Reconfigure is available only while the run is waiting, running, blocked or paused; a completed run is never reconfigured (CWR-031).

source_surface.description: A registered source surface of the command's catalog row; the surface census is owned by Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md.

BrainstormRoundResult.description: Advances exactly one protocol round; cannot skip blind proposals or exceed the configured debate rounds (section 10).

BrainstormSynthesisRequest.description: Requests Plan creation from the Plan owner (section 8.7). The on-screen label is Write the plan; the command is unchanged (DL-134).

source_surface.description: A registered source surface of the command's catalog row; the surface census is owned by Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md.

tie_resolution.description: Accepted on a tied vote: the coordinator adjudicates by hard constraints and evidence, never by response order (CWR-027, CWR-031).

AssistantPlanCreateResult.description: The Plan owner's create result as this command returns it: exactly one Plan. Plan identity and version semantics stay owned by Plans/Assistant_Plan_Runtime.md.

BrainstormLeadResearchRequest.description: Asks a running or waiting BrainStorm run to research one Wonderer lead (CWR-031, DL-130, section 9.2).

source_surface.description: A registered source surface of the command's catalog row; the surface census is owned by Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md.

BrainstormLeadResearchResult.description: The lead stays a hypothesis until research returns evidence; the result records that evidence or the reason it was set aside. A lead is never accepted as fact without evidence.

ReviewCreateTodosRequest.description: Converts only the final explicit selection of confirmed findings (CWR-026).

source_surface.description: A registered source surface of the command's catalog row; the surface census is owned by Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md.

ReviewCreateTodosResult.description: Each To-Do keeps lineage back to its finding_id (section 7.6).

source_surface.description: A registered source surface of the command's catalog row; the surface census is owned by Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md.

ComposerBufferResult.description: cmd.review.send_findings_to_agent fills the source thread's empty composer buffer with a fix request, records the lineage in message metadata and never in the text, and refuses composer_not_empty when the buffer holds text (CWR-031, DL-125).

sent.description: Never sends: nothing runs until the user presses Send (DL-125).

ReviewRunAgainRequest.description: Starts a new review run against a newly frozen target pack (restart_on_current); it never reuses a stale pack. Returns CollaborationStartResult.

ChatRoomRoundResult.description: Advances exactly one round under the unchanged turn policy and returns the deterministic participant order used (section 10).

ArtifactResult.description: A synthesis artifact through the artifact owner; it creates no To-Do, Plan or Goal and does not end the room (section 10).

ChatRoomPromotePlanRequest.description: Explicit promotion only, with source lineage to run, message and participant; routed to the owner, which admits or rejects (section 6.4).

ChatRoomEndRequest.description: Ends a running, waiting or paused Chat Room (CWR-024, CWR-031, DL-130). Distinct from cmd.collaboration.cancel.

ChatRoomEndResult.description: The room takes no further rounds or messages and settles completed, never cancelled; promotion of existing messages stays allowed.

crew_auto_rules.description: The committed Crew Auto criteria read by evaluate(criteria, request_features) (section 5.3, CWR-021). The complexity threshold's value set is the owner's configuration and is not closed here.

CrewAutoSetRequest.description: One click, one command: enabling carries the rules and the team together, committed through the project Settings transaction (CWR-038, MODAL-006..008).

team.description: The Crew Auto team: core members only; specialists are refused in Crew Auto teams (CWR-028).

CrewAutoSetResult.description: The check reflects effective stored state: it is on only after a committed configuration and a successful project Settings commit; without a configuration the result is configuration_required (MODAL-006..008, section 10).

CrewAutoConfigRoute.description: Opens the Crew Auto sheet from the Crew Auto settings… row or the Crew sheet (CWR-038).

RouteResult.description: Route success is not enablement; the check changes only through cmd.chat.crew_auto.set (section 10, CWR-038).
